description: Turn a video attachment into an editable Repostit Brief for the social accounts you have already connected. List your destinations, prepare a video with a caption, schedule it for a specific time, or queue it for immediate publishing after confirming the action. Check delivery status to see which posts are queued, which need attention, and which have a published link. A Repostit account with connected social accounts is required.

defaultPrompt: List the social accounts I have connected to Repostit.
Turn my attached video into a Repostit Brief and help me choose the connected accounts.
Check the delivery status of my Repostit Brief and show the available post links.
